claim_limits.latency: Prototype completion timings are separate from V7/V8 outer Results completion. Small saved-case evidence does not establish an SLA or population reliability.

claim_limits.confirmation: Joint success requires each manifest run to be actual V7 or V8, independently H/U passing, protocol clean, mechanically clean, delivered, and under 20 seconds; coverage is reported separately.
